newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end flat, seen capped at 1,080.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end flat, seen capped at 1,080.

text.p: Austrian shares ended mixed on Friday after a relatively quiet week, and traders said they saw the index struggling to top 1,080.
The main focus would be the expiry of November futures and options next Friday.
"The expiry will come around 1,080, whether just above or below," said one trader. Another said: "Everyone is waiting for the expiry so they can take up new positions."

The past week had been disappointing, according to traders. In the course of the week the ATX blue chip index had edged up just 3.13 points, while in New York the Dow Jones raced to new highs, boosted by the U.S. election result.
Today the ATX gained 1.49 points or 0.14 percent to close at 1,070.20. Among its constituents 13 shares rose, two were unchanged and six fell.
Regional utility EVN, which is expected to present record 1995/6 results on Tuesday, was among the most actively traded stocks.
Also the top gainer of the session, EVN jumped 35 schillings to 1,524 on 40,522 lots.
The leading decliner was luxury hosiery maker Wolford, dropping 90 schillings to 1,270 due to lower-than-expected first-half sales reported on Thursday.
The November ATX future added 1.0 point to close at 1,070.5 on turnover of 517 contracts.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index shed 0.14 points or 0.03 percent to end at 411.55. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
